stories.headline: HappyRobot Vaults to $1.2 Billion Valuation as Enterprise Demand for AI Automation Soars
stories.body: Artificial intelligence (AI) agent platform HappyRobot was valued at $1.2 billion post-money in a Series C funding round in which it raised $150 million, the company said in an Aug. 4 press release. stories.headline: States sue OCC over mortgage escrow interest pre-emption
stories.body: A 10-state coalition is asking a federal court to put a halt to the OCC's rules which pre-empt laws on banks paying interest on mortgage escrow deposits.
